description: A full bot match runs without errors: freeze, live, end, next round, match end at 13 rounds, score reset.
acceptance: Headless match of 10 min shows rounds advancing, correct winner per round, no exceptions in log, match restarts after 13 wins.
test: Run headless match 10 min; parse REPORT lines; grep Exception.
evidence: 2026-11-24: 4 min headless match, 7 rounds, score 6:1, 0 exceptions. 13-round end not yet observed.

description: Bots move, take cover, fight both teams fairly; attackers carry and plant the bomb; defenders defuse.

evidence: 2026-11-24: team plan (defender holds, two attacker routes, staged execute, escorts) implemented; compiles; awaiting headless verification.

description: Round never ends prematurely or with a wrong winner (time-out = defenders win; bomb exploded = attackers; defused = defenders; elimination).
